description: Does proctor drive each vendor agent through Harbor and read back what Harbor wrote? Every assistant talks to the stub fixture's scripted model, so a try costs nothing.

script.about: what the stub model is scripted to do; each script is one stage, and a try is that stage alone, since an outage would lose the stages beside it

ok.note: the stub asks for one shell command, then lists the tools the agent offered

hang.note: the stub asks for one shell command, then never answers

fail.note: the stub answers every request with a 500

assistant.about: the vendor's agent at its pin, each on the stub's endpoint in its own wire shape

claude-code.note: Claude Code at code-change's pin, on the stub's Anthropic Messages endpoint

codex.note: Codex at code-change's pin, on the stub's OpenAI Responses endpoint

qwen-code.note: Qwen Code at code-change's pin, on the stub's OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint

stages.about: The stub asks for one shell command, then lists the tools the agent offered
stages.prompt: Run the command the stub names. STUB:run=echo stub > made.txt

stages.about: The stub asks for one shell command, then never answers: the agent's time budget ends a completed run
stages.prompt: The second answer never comes. STUB:hang

stages.about: The stub answers every request with a 500: an outage, so the attempt is failed, never a run
